elsewhere.label: covered elsewhere

none.label: no such function
none.note: The airline's current website has no such function.

footnotes.adbooking: Air Dolomiti sells through its own booking engine, not Lufthansa's shop. Since 1 November the search form is on the replica's homepages, route pages and booking pages and hands the trip to that engine, as www does; the engine's bot check can show a captcha, as it can on www.
footnotes.lhbooking: Lufthansa's manage booking and hotel tabs hand over to two services that run in AEM today. Their replacements answer with test data, and since 1 November the tabs post to them on the airline's own address; on the replica's addresses they keep opening www, so no real booking reaches test data.
footnotes.signin: On Discover, ITA, Austrian and Brussels Airlines, manage booking goes through a deep link to the login and profile pages, which are on the new platform since 1 November. The services behind the deep link answer with test data, and since 1 November the replicas' addresses route the deep link to them, so it ends on the replica's login page.
footnotes.lhpages: Three Lufthansa pages with these functions aren't on the replica yet: check-in deadlines, the compensation claim and the newsletter. They are being imported now, the check-in page with the search block that is live on Austrian and Brussels Airlines. Until then our pages link to www.
footnotes.travelidapps: The help center and culinary hub apps are in the shared code and load on our pages, but their data comes from the airline's Travel ID service, which refuses our test addresses. They work once the site runs on the airline's own address, or once Lufthansa allows ours.
footnotes.adown: Switching off Air Dolomiti's current website is a goal, so its timetable, manage booking, newsletter and eSIM pages get versions of their own. Its booking service answers our addresses, so timetable and manage booking can work as on www; the newsletter becomes a form on our own forms service.
footnotes.cargostays: Cargo's booking, schedules, customer portal, station finder and eServices stay on Cargo's current systems; the new site links to them.
footnotes.cargomoves: Cargo's public pages move completely: contact forms, notifications, help and contact search, the newsletter page and the tracking entry form get versions on the new platform.
footnotes.cargonews: Cargo's newsletter form loads from Lufthansa Cargo's Microsoft Dynamics, which takes sign-ups only from sites Cargo allows. Lufthansa Cargo has to allow our address for form hosting in its Dynamics settings; until then the embed stays off and the page links to Cargo's own newsletter page.
footnotes.oschat: Austrian's chat assistant is loaded from Austrian's website, outside AEM. Since 1 November its button shows on the 213 pages that have it on www, in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian.
footnotes.adchat: Air Dolomiti's chat assistant is built into the replica, but its switch stays off: the chat vendor sends no chat to our address until Air Dolomiti or the vendor adds a rule for it.
footnotes.travelid: Personal content for signed-in customers needs Lufthansa: Travel ID, the group's login, accepts only the airline's own website as the address to return to and as the site allowed to call it. The replicas can't sign anyone in until they run on the airline's address, or Lufthansa allows ours.
footnotes.sndest: Brussels Airlines' fare teasers, homepage slider and offers grid load live prices, but their cards open a destination page address the replica doesn't have. Brussels Airlines' own destination page works on the replica, and one brand setting points the cards at it.
footnotes.snchat: Brussels Airlines' chat assistant loads from Brussels Airlines' website, outside AEM, as Austrian's does. Since 1 November its button shows on the pages that have it on www, in all six languages.
footnotes.adesim: Air Dolomiti's eSIM shop (from the vendor Breeze) is built into the replica, but its switch stays off: Breeze answers every call from our address with 403, because the widget's key belongs to Air Dolomiti's site. It works once Air Dolomiti or Breeze allows our address.
